passage:
Robin is walking Stitch the bulldog. They walk to a patch of mud beside a big ditch. Robin tosses a stick and Stitch dashes to fetch it. The stick lands on
the edge of the mud. “Oh no! That is a bad place for the stick to land,” thinks Robin.

“Stop Stitch!” she yells. Stitch stops and does not budge. Robin walks up to the edge and grabs the stick. “Good job Stitch! I got your stick. Do you want it back?” Robin tosses the stick and Stitch
jumps to catch it.
